title: permitmatrix.contract/1
description: Permit Matrix authorization contract. Passing this schema is necessary but not sufficient: it mirrors the engine's size limits (LIMITS), identifier and path patterns and enumerations, but cross-references by id (principal roles, record owners, endpoint resources and roles, flaw endpoints), duplicate ids and routes, the mock:// or loopback-only servers rule and the 64 KB UTF-8 byte limit are enforced only by validateContract in src/engine/contract.ts, which also normalises the document (adds the 'fixed' build when absent and drops unknown keys).
$comment: Hand-maintained alongside LIMITS in src/engine/contract.ts; src/engine/__tests__/schema.test.ts asserts the two agree.

schema.description: Format marker; the importer uses it to tell a contract from an OpenAPI document.

servers.description: Targets the contract describes. Only mock://<host> or an http(s) URL whose host is localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1] is accepted; anything else is refused by validateContract with 'External target refused'. This schema checks only type and length.

roles.description: Roles a principal may hold. Ids must be unique (checked by validateContract). LIMITS.maxRoles = 8.

principals.description: Synthetic callers. Ids must be unique and every role must exist (checked by validateContract). LIMITS.maxPrincipals = 24.

resources.description: Record collections the endpoints operate on. Ids must be unique (checked by validateContract). LIMITS.maxResources = 12.

endpoints.description: Operations under test, in matrix order. Ids and method + path pairs must be unique (checked by validateContract). LIMITS.maxEndpoints = 40.

builds.description: Named server builds keyed by build id. Each seeds flaws into the mock server; validateContract adds a 'fixed' build with no flaws when none is declared.

text.description: Any free-text value (labels, tenants). LIMITS.maxStringLength = 200; may be empty.

id.description: Identifier: 1–64 characters, starts with a letter or digit, then letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'. Matched case-insensitively by the engine, so the pattern lists both cases.

actorId.description: Role or principal identifier. 'anonymous' (any letter case) is reserved for the synthetic unauthenticated caller; ECMA-262 patterns have no inline flags, so each letter is spelled in both cases.

fieldName.description: Record field name, writable/sensitive field entry or build key: the id pattern minus the names that collide with Object.prototype.

fieldValue.description: Record field values are scalars only (string, finite number, boolean or null); nested objects and arrays are refused. JSON cannot encode a non-finite number, so no further constraint is needed here.

fieldList.description: Distinct field names. LIMITS.maxListLength = 1000 caps every list the engine walks.

role.description: Must equal the id of a declared role (checked by validateContract).

owner.description: Must equal the id of a declared principal (checked by validateContract).

fields.description: Scalar field values keyed by field name. LIMITS.maxFieldsPerRecord = 24.

records.description: Seed records for the mock server. LIMITS.maxRecordsPerResource = 100; may be empty.

roles.description: Distinct ids of the roles allowed to call the endpoint; an endpoint nobody may call is an error.

ownership.description: Object scope: any record, only records the caller owns, or only records in the caller's tenant.

path.description: Route template: '/' followed by non-empty literal segments ([A-Za-z0-9_-]) and at most one parameter, which must be spelled {id}. Each method + path pair may appear once (checked by validateContract).

resource.description: Must equal the id of a declared resource (checked by validateContract).

writableFields.description: Fields a PATCH/PUT/POST body may change; any other field in the body must be ignored.

sensitiveFields.description: Fields that must never appear in a GET response body.

endpoint.description: Must equal the id of a declared endpoint (checked by validateContract).

flaws.description: Checks this build switches off. LIMITS.maxFlawsPerBuild = 40.
